title: Railroad
html:
When a factory and a city or port are placed near eachother, railroads will be spawned to connect the buildings together. Trains may only travel where a Railroad exists.

Adding further buildings within this distance will cause more rail to be spawned, creating a mesh. It is also possible to make a train loop.

On launch, the following buildings are able to be connected:

  • Factory
  • City
  • Port

The maximum distance within which a factory, city or port can connect to another station to form a railroad is 80.

The maximum length that a single railroad connection can be is 100.

As of Update 34.0, rails can no longer cross impassable terrain, and trains no longer despawn when a track splits. Railroads and trains can also be recoloured with cosmetic effects from the store.
